method: GET summary, features, dependencies for v1.38 every 5 s for 660 s (crosses two 5-minute cache expiries); local Docker, laptop
after_notes: The one slow 'after' request (29.6 s) was the first request after the redeploy, sent while the boot warm-up was computing (log: view computed 19:05:19, 21.4 s). The TTL expiry at about 19:10 was recomputed in the background (24.5 s) with no slow request. The merge-date backtest started during the last ~3 minutes of the run (CPU contention; makes 'after' look worse, not better).
